beginner.stem: Which history line belongs to Actinium?
options: Charcoal, soot, and diamond were known long before anyone called them one element.
Magnesia, a white earth from Magnesia in Greece, was long confused with lime.
Carl Wilhelm Scheele recognized a new earth in pyrolusite, and Johan Gottlieb Gahn reduced that ore to the metal in 1774.
